description: This file is a Perl script that acts as a wrapper for the MSVC 'lib.exe' tool on Windows. It processes command-line arguments to facilitate building static libraries with MSVC using GNU Make, by adjusting or filtering arguments before invoking 'lib.exe'.

methods.name: main
methods.description: The script's main execution flow, processing command-line arguments and invoking 'lib.exe' with the modified argument list.
